21.4: Thus said Jehovah, God of Israel: Indeed, I am turning round the weapons of battle That are in your hand, With which you do fight the king of Babylon, And the Chaldeans, who are laying siege against you, At the outside of the wall, And I have gathered them into the midst of this city,
21.5: And I--I have fought against you, With a stretched-out hand, and with a strong arm, And in anger, and in fury, and in great wrath,
21.6: And I have smitten the inhabitants of this city, Both man and beast, By a great pestilence do they die.
21.7: And after this--an affirmation of Jehovah, I give Zedekiah king of Judah, And his servants, and the people, And those left in this city, From the pestilence, from the sword, and from the famine, Into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, And into the hand of their enemies, And into the hand of those seeking their life, And he has smitten them by the mouth of the sword, He has no pity on them, Nor does he spare, nor has he mercy.
21.8: And to this people you do say, Thus said Jehovah: Indeed, I am setting before you the way of life, And the way of death!
21.9: Whoever is abiding in this city--dies, By sword, and by famine, and by pestilence, And whoever is going forth, And has fallen to the Chaldeans, Who are laying siege against you--lives, And his life has been to him for a spoil.
21.10: For I have set My face against this city for evil, And not for good--an affirmation of Jehovah. Into the hand of the king of Babylon it is given, And he has burned it with fire.
21.11: And as to the house of the king of Judah, Hear you a word of Jehovah;
21.12: O house of David, thus said Jehovah: Decide you judgment at morning, And deliver the plundered from the hand of the oppressor, Lest My fury go forth as fire, And has burned, and none is quenching, Because of the evil of your doings.
21.13: Indeed, I am against you--an affirmation of Jehovah, O inhabitant of the valley, rock of the plain, Who are saying, Who comes down against us? And who comes into our habitations?
21.14: And I have laid a charge against you, According to the fruit of your doings, An affirmation of Jehovah, And I have kindled a fire in its forest, And it has consumed--all its suburbs!

22.1: Thus said Jehovah, `Go down to the house of the king of Judah, and you have spoken there this word, and have said,
22.2: Hear a word of Jehovah, O king of Judah, who are sitting on the throne of David, you, and your servants, and your people, who are coming in at these gates,
22.3: Thus said Jehovah: Do you judgment and righteousness, And deliver the plundered from the hand of the oppressor, And sojourner, orphan, and widow, you do not oppress nor wrong, And innocent blood you do not shed in this place.
22.4: For, if you certainly do this thing, Then come in by the gates of this house Have kings sitting for David on his throne, Riding on chariot, and on horses, He, and his servants, and his people.
22.5: And if you do not hear these words, By myself I have sworn--an affirmation of Jehovah, That this house is for a desolation.
22.6: For thus said Jehovah, Concerning the house of the king of Judah: Gilead are you to Me--head of Lebanon, If not--I make you a wilderness, Cities not inhabited.
22.7: And I have separated for you destroyers, Each with his weapons, And they have cut down the choice of your cedars, And have cast them on the fire.
22.8: And many nations have passed by this city, And they have said, each to his neighbour, For what has Jehovah done thus to this great city?
22.9: And they have said, `Because that they have forsaken The covenant of Jehovah their God, And bow themselves to other gods, and serve them.'
22.10: You do not weep for the dead, nor bemoan for him, Weep you sore for the traveller, For he does not return again, Nor has he seen the land of his birth.
22.11: For thus said Jehovah concerning Shallum son of Josiah king of Judah, who is reigning instead of Josiah his father, who has gone forth from this place: He does not turn back here again;
22.12: For in the place where they have removed him he dies, And this land he does not see again.
22.13: Woe to him who is building his house by unrighteousness, And his upper chambers by injustice, On his neighbour he lays service for nought, And his wage he does not give to him.
22.14: Who is saying, `I build for myself a large house, And airy upper chambers,' And he has cut out for himself its windows, Ceiled with cedar, and painted with vermilion.
22.15: Do you reign, because you are fretting yourself in cedar? Your father--did he not eat and drink? Yes, he did judgment and righteousness, Then it is well with him.
22.16: He decided the cause of the poor and needy, Then it is well--is it not to know Me? An affirmation of Jehovah.
22.17: But your eyes and your heart are not, Except on your dishon gain, And on shedding of innocent blood, And on oppression, and on doing of violence.
22.18: Therefore, thus said Jehovah concerning Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah: They do not lament for him, Ah, my brother, and Ah, sister, They do not lament for him, Ah, lord, and Ah, his honour.
22.19: The burial of an ass--he is buried, Dragged and cast out from there to the gates of Jerusalem.
22.20: Go up to Lebanon, and cry, And in Bashan give forth your voice, And cry from Abarim, For destroyed have been all loving you.
22.21: I have spoken to you in your ease, You have said, `I do not hearken,' This is your way from your youth, For you have not hearkened to My voice.
22.22: All your friends consume does wind, And your lovers into captivity do go, Surely then you are ashamed, And have blushed for all your wickedness.
22.23: O dweller in Lebanon, making a nest among cedars, How gracious have you been when pangs come to you, Pain--as of a travailing woman.
22.24: I live--an affirmation of Jehovah, Though Coniah son of Jehoiakim king of Judah Were a seal on My right hand, Surely from there I draw you away,
22.25: And I have given you into the hand of those seeking your life, And into hands of which you are afraid, Into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, And into the hand of the Chaldeans.
22.26: And I have cast you, And your mother who bore you, to another country, Where you were not born, and there do you die.
22.27: And to the land where they are lifting up their soul to return, There they do not return.
22.28: A grief--a despised broken thing--is this man Coniah? A vessel in which there is no pleasure? Wherefore have they been cast up and down, He and his seed, Yes, they were cast on to a land that they knew not?
22.29: Earth, earth, earth, hear a word of Jehovah,
22.30: Thus said Jehovah: Write you this man childless, A man--he does not prosper in his days, For none of his seed does prosper, Sitting on the throne of David, And ruling again in Judah!

23.1: Woe to shepherds destroying, And scattering the flock of My pasture, An affirmation of Jehovah.
23.2: Therefore, thus said Jehovah, God of Israel, Against the shepherds who feed My people, You have scattered My flock, and drive them away, And have not inspected them, Indeed, I am charging on you the evil of your doings, An affirmation of Jehovah.
23.3: And I do gather the remnant of My flock Out of all the lands where I drove them, And have brought them back to their fold, And they have been fruitful, and multiplied.
23.4: And I have raised for them shepherds, And they have fed them, And they fear no more, nor are affrighted, Nor are they lacking--an affirmation of Jehovah.
23.5: Indeed, days are coming--an affirmation of Jehovah, And I have raised to David a righteous shoot, And a king has reigned and acted wisely, And done judgment and righteousness in the earth.
23.6: In his days is Judah saved, and Israel dwells confidently, And this his name that Jehovah proclaims him, `Our Righteousness.'
23.7: Therefore, indeed, days are coming, An affirmation of Jehovah, And they do not say any more, Jehovah lives who brought up The sons of Israel out of the land of Egypt,
23.8: But--Jehovah lives, who brought up, And who brought in, the seed of the house of Israel, From the land of the north, And from all the lands where I drove them, And they have dwelt on their own ground!
23.9: In reference to the prophets: Broken has been my heart in my midst, Fluttered have all my bones, I have been as a man--a drunkard, And as a man--wine has passed over him, Because of Jehovah, and of His holy words.
23.10: For of adulterers has the land been full, For because of these has the land mourned, Dried up has been the pleasant places of the wilderness, And their course is evil, and their might--not right.
23.11: For both prophet and priest have been profane, Yes, in My house I found their wickedness, An affirmation of Jehovah.
23.12: Therefore is their way to them as slippery places, Into thick darkness they are driven, And they have fallen in it, For I bring in against them evil, The year of their inspection, An affirmation of Jehovah.
23.13: And in prophets of Samaria I have seen folly, They have prophesied by Baal, And cause my people--Israel--to err.
23.14: And in prophets of Jerusalem I have seen a horrible thing, Committing adultery, and walking falsely, Yes, they strengthened the hands of evil doers, So that they have not turned back Each from his wickedness, They have been to me--all of them--as Sodom, And its inhabitants as Gomorrah.
23.15: Therefore, thus said Jehovah of Hosts, concerning the prophets: Indeed, I am causing them to eat wormwood, And have caused them to drink water of gall, For, from prophets of Jerusalem Has profanity gone forth to all the land.
23.16: Thus said Jehovah of Hosts: You do not hearken to the words Of the prophets who are prophesying to you, They are making you vain things, A vision of their own heart they speak, Not from the mouth of Jehovah.
23.17: Saying diligently to those despising The word of Jehovah: Peace is for you, And to every one walking in the stubbornness of his heart they have said: Evil does not come in to you.
23.18: For who has stood in the counsel of Jehovah, And sees and hears His word? Who has regarded My word, and hearkens?
23.19: Indeed, a whirlwind of Jehovah--Fury has gone out, even a piercing whirlwind, On the head of the wicked it stays.
23.20: The anger of Jehovah does not turn back Till His doing, and till His establishing, The thoughts of His heart, In the latter end of the days you attend to it With understanding.
23.21: I have not sent the prophets, and they have run, I have not spoken to them, and they have prophesied.
23.22: But--if they stood in My counsel, Then they cause My people to hear My words, And they turn them back from their evil way, And from the evil of their doings.
23.23: A God near am I--an affirmation of Jehovah, And not a God afar off?
23.24: Is any one hidden in secret places, And I see him not? an affirmation of Jehovah, Do not I fill the heavens and the earth? An affirmation of Jehovah.
23.25: I have heard that which the prophets said, Who prophesy in My name falsehood, saying, `I have dreamed, I have dreamed.'
23.26: Till when is it in the heart of the prophets? The prophets of falsehood, Yes, prophets of the deceit of their heart,
23.27: Who are devising to cause My people To forget My name by their dreams, That they recount each to his neighbour, As their fathers forgot my name for Baal.
23.28: The prophet with whom is a dream, Let him recount the dream, And he with whom is My word, Let him truly speak My word. What--to the straw with the corn? An affirmation of Jehovah.
23.29: Is it not thus? My word is as a fire, An affirmation of Jehovah. And as a hammer--it breaks in pieces a rock.
23.30: Therefore, indeed, I am against the prophets, An affirmation of Jehovah, Stealing My words each from his neighbour.
23.31: Indeed, I am against the prophets, An affirmation of Jehovah, Who are making smooth their tongue, And they affirm--an affirmation.
23.32: Indeed, I am against the prophets of false dreams, An affirmation of Jehovah, And they recount them, and cause my people to err, By their falsehoods, and by their instability, And I--I have not sent them, Nor have I commanded them, And they are not at all profitable to this people, An affirmation of Jehovah.
23.33: And when this people, or the prophet, Or a priest, does ask you, saying, What is the burden of Jehovah? Then you have said to them: You are the burden, and I have left you, An affirmation of Jehovah.
23.34: And the prophet, and the priest, and the people, That says, The burden of Jehovah, I have seen after that man, and after his house.
23.35: Thus do you say each to his neighbour, And each to his brother: What has Jehovah answered? And what has Jehovah spoken?
23.36: And the burden of Jehovah you do not mention any more, For the burden to each is--His word, And you have overturned the words of the living God, Jehovah of Hosts, our God.
23.37: Thus do you say to the prophet What has Jehovah answered you? And what has Jehovah spoken?
23.38: And if the burden of Jehovah you say, Therefore thus said Jehovah: Because of your saying this word, The burden of Jehovah, And I do send to you, saying, You do not say, The burden of Jehovah.
23.39: Therefore, indeed, I--I have taken you utterly away, And I have sent you out, And the city that I gave to you, And to your fathers, from before My face,
23.40: And I have put on you reproach age-during, And shame age-during that is not forgotten!

24.1: Jehovah has showed me, and indeed, two baskets of figs, appointed before the temple of Jehovah, --after the removing by Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, of Jeconiah, son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, and the heads of Judah, and the artisan, and the smith, from Jerusalem, when he brings them into Babylon--
24.2: In the one basket are figs very good, like the first-ripe figs, and in the other basket are figs very bad, that are not eaten for badness.
24.3: And Jehovah says to me, `What are you seeing, Jeremiah?' and I say, `Figs, the good figs are very good, and the bad are very bad, that are not eaten for badness.'
24.4: And there is a word of Jehovah to me, saying:
24.5: Thus said Jehovah, God of Israel, Like these good figs so do I acknowledge The removed of Judah--that I sent from this place, To the land of the Chaldeans--for good.
24.6: And I have set My eyes on them for good, And have brought them back to this land, And built them up, and I throw not down, And have planted them, and pluck not up.
24.7: And have given to them a heart to know Me, For I am Jehovah, And they have been to Me for a people, And I am to them for God, For they turned back to Me with all their heart.
24.8: And like the bad figs, that are not eaten for badness, Surely thus said Jehovah: So do I make Zedekiah king of Judah, And his heads, and the remnant of Jerusalem, Who are left in this land, And who are dwelling in the land of Egypt,
24.9: And I have given them for a trembling, For evil--to all kingdoms of the earth, For a reproach, and for a simile, For a byword, and for a reviling, In all the places where I drive them.
24.10: And I have sent against them the sword, The famine and the pestilence, Till their consumption from off the ground, That I gave to them and to their fathers!

25.1: The word that has been to Jeremiah concerning all the people of Judah, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, --it is the first year of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, --
25.2: Which Jeremiah the prophet has spoken concerning all the people of Judah, even to all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, saying:
25.3: `From the thirteenth year of Josiah son of Amon king of Judah, and to this day--this three and twentieth year--has the word of Jehovah been to me, and I speak to you, rising early and speaking, and you have not hearkened;
25.4: And Jehovah has sent to you all His servants, the prophets, rising early and sending, and you have not hearkened, nor inclined your ear to hear, saying:
25.5: `Turn back, I pray you, each from his evil way, and from the evil of your doings, and dwell on the ground that Jehovah has given to you and to your fathers from age to age,
25.6: And you do not go after other gods to serve them, and to bow yourselves to them, nor do you provoke Me to anger with the work of your hands, and I do no evil to you;
25.7: And you have not hearkened to Me--an affirmation of Jehovah--so as to provoke Me to anger with the work of your hands for evil to you.
25.8: `Therefore thus said Jehovah of Hosts, Because that you have not obeyed My words,
25.9: Indeed, I am sending, and have taken all the families of the north--an affirmation of Jehovah--even to Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, My servant, and have brought them in against this land, and against its inhabitants, and against all these nations round about, and have devoted them, and appointed them for an astonishment, and for a hissing, and for wastes age-during.
25.10: And I have destroyed from them the voice of rejoicing, and the voice of joy, voice of bridegroom and voice of bride, noise of millstones, and the light of lamps.
25.11: And all this land has been for a waste, for an astonishment, and these nations have served the king of Babylon seventy years.
25.12: `And it has come to pass, at the fulness of seventy years, I charge against the king of Babylon, and against that nation--an affirmation of Jehovah--their iniquity, and against the land of the Chaldeans, and have appointed it for desolations age-during.
25.13: And I have brought in on that land all My words that I have spoken against it, all that is written in this book, that Jeremiah has prophesied concerning all the nations.
25.14: For laid service on them--also them--have many nations and great kings, and I have given recompence to them according to their doing, and according to the work of their hands.
25.15: `For thus said Jehovah God of Israel to me, Take the wine cup of this fury out of My hand, and you have caused all the nations to drink it to whom I am sending you;
25.16: And they have drunk, and shaken themselves and shown themselves foolish, because of the sword that I am sending among them.
25.17: `And I take the cup out of the hand of Jehovah, and cause all the nations to drink to whom Jehovah sent me:
25.18: Jerusalem, and the cities of Judah, And its kings, its heads, To give them to waste, to astonishment, To hissing, and to reviling, as at this day.
25.19: Pharaoh king of Egypt, and his servants, And his heads, and all his people,
25.20: And all the mixed people, And all the kings of the land of Uz, And all the kings of the land of the Philistines, And Ashkelon, and Gazzah, and Ekron, And the remnant of Ashdod,
25.21: Edom, and Moab, and the sons of Ammon,
25.22: And all the kings of Tyre, And all the kings of Zidon, And the kings of the isle that is beyond the sea,
25.23: Dedan, and Tema, and Buz, And all cutting the corners of the beard,
25.24: And all the kings of Arabia, And all the kings of the mixed people, Who are dwelling in the wilderness,
25.25: And all the kings of Zimri, And all the kings of Elam, And all the kings of Media,
25.26: And all the kings of the north, The near and the far off, one to another, And all the kingdoms of the earth, That are on the face of the ground, And king Sheshach drinks after them.
25.27: And you have said to them: Thus said Jehovah of Hosts God of Israel, Drink you, yes drink abundantly, And vomit, and fall, and rise not, Because of the sword that I am sending among you.
25.28: And it has come to pass, When they refuse to receive the cup out of your hand to drink, That you have said to them: Thus said Jehovah of Hosts, You do certainly drink.
25.29: For indeed, in the city over which My name is called, I am beginning to do evil, And you--you are entirely acquitted! You are not acquitted, for a sword I am proclaiming, For all inhabitants of the land, An affirmation of Jehovah of Hosts.
25.30: And you, you do prophesy to them all these words, and have said to them: Jehovah from the high place does roar, And from His holy habitation gives forth His voice, He surely roars for His habitation, A shout as of treaders down, God answers all the inhabitants of the land,
25.31: Wasting has come to the end of the earth, For a controversy has Jehovah with nations, He has executed judgment for all flesh, The wicked! He has given them to the sword, An affirmation of Jehovah.
25.32: Thus said Jehovah of Hosts: Indeed, evil is going out from nation to nation, And a great whirlwind is stirred up from the sides of the earth.
25.33: And the pierced of Jehovah have been in that day, From the end of the earth even to the end of the earth, They are not lamented, nor gathered, nor buried, For dung on the face of the ground they are.
25.34: Howl, you shepherds, and cry, And roll yourselves, you honourable of the flock, For full have been your days, For slaughtering, and for your scatterings, And you have fallen as a desirable vessel.
25.35: And perished has refuge from the shepherds, And escape from the honourable of the flock.
25.36: A voice is of the cry of the shepherds, And a howling of the honourable of the flock, For Jehovah is spoiling their pasture.
25.37: And the peaceable habitations have been cut down, Because of the fierceness of the anger of Jehovah.
25.38: He has forsaken, as a young lion, His covert, Surely their land has become a desolation, Because of the oppressing fierceness, And because of the fierceness of His anger!

26.1: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah, has this word been from Jehovah, saying:
26.2: `Thus said Jehovah, Stand you in the court of the house of Jehovah, and you have spoken to all those of the cities of Judah who are coming in to bow themselves in the house of Jehovah, all the words that I have commanded you to speak to them, you do not diminish a word.
26.3: If so be they hearken, and turn back each from his evil way, then I have repented concerning the evil that I am thinking of doing to them, because of the evil of their doings.
26.4: `And you have said to them: Thus said Jehovah, If you do not hearken to Me, to walk in My law, that I set before you,
26.5: To hearken to the words of My servants the prophets, whom I am sending to you, yes, rising early and sending, and you have not hearkened,
26.6: Then I have given up this house as Shiloh, and this city I give up for a reviling to all nations of the earth.'
26.7: And the priests, and the prophets, and all the people, hear Jeremiah speaking these words in the house of Jehovah,
26.8: And it comes to pass, at the completion of Jeremiah's speaking all that Jehovah has commanded him to speak to all the people, that the priests, and the prophets, and all the people catch him, saying, You do surely die,
26.9: Wherefore have you prophesied in the name of Jehovah, saying, `As Shiloh this house shall be, and this city is wasted, without inhabitant?' and all the people are assembled to Jeremiah in the house of Jehovah.
26.10: And the heads of Judah hear these things, and they go up from the house of the king to the house of Jehovah, and sit in the opening of the new gate of Jehovah.
26.11: And the priests and the prophets speak to the heads, and to all the people, saying, `Judgment of death is for this man, for he has prophesied against this city, as you have heard with your ears.'
26.12: And Jeremiah speaks to all the heads, and to all the people, saying, `Jehovah sent me to prophesy concerning this house, and concerning this city, all the words that you have heard;
26.13: And now, amend your ways, and your doings, and hearken to the voice of Jehovah your God, and Jehovah does repent concerning the evil that He has spoken against you.
26.14: `And I, indeed, I am in your hand, do to me as is good and as is right in your eyes;
26.15: Only, know you certainly, that if you are putting me to death, surely innocent blood you are putting on yourselves, and on this city, and on its inhabitants; for truly has Jehovah sent me to you to speak in your ears all these words.'
26.16: And the heads and all the people say to the priests and to the prophets, `There is not for this man a judgment of death, for in the name of Jehovah our God he has spoken to us.'
26.17: And certain of the elders of the land rise up, and speak to all the assembly of the people, saying,
26.18: `Micah the Morashtite has been prophesying in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and he says to all the people of Judah, saying: Thus said Jehovah of Hosts: Zion is a plowed field, and Jerusalem is heaps, And the mountain of the house is for high places of a forest.
26.19: `Put him at all to death did Hezekiah king of Judah, and all Judah? Did he not fear Jehovah? yes, he appeases the face of Jehovah, and Jehovah repents concerning the evil that He spoke against them; and we are doing great evil against our souls.
26.20: `And also there has been a man prophesying in the name of Jehovah, Urijah son of Shemaiah, of Kirjath-Jearim, and he prophesies against this city, and against this land according to all the words of Jeremiah,
26.21: And the king Jehoiakim, and all his mighty ones, and all the heads, hear his words, and the king seeks to put him to death, and Urijah hears, and fears, and flees, and goes in to Egypt.
26.22: And the king Jehoiakim sends men to Egypt--Elnathan son of Achbor, and men with him to Egypt--
26.23: And they bring out Urijah from Egypt, and bring him in to the king Jehoiakim, and he smites him with a sword, and casts his corpse to the graves of the sons of the people.'
26.24: Only, the hand of Ahikam son of Shaphan has been with Jeremiah so as not to give him up into the hand of the people to put him to death.

27.1: In the beginning of the reign of Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah, has this word been to Jeremiah from Jehovah, saying,
27.2: `Thus said Jehovah to me, Make to you bands and yokes,
27.3: And you have put them on your neck, and have sent them to the king of Edom, and to the king of Moab, and to the king of the sons of Ammon, and to the king of Tyre, and to the king of Zidon, by the hand of messengers who are coming in to Jerusalem, to Zedekiah king of Judah;
27.4: And you have commanded them for their lords, saying, Thus said Jehovah of Hosts, God of Israel,
27.5: Thus do you say to your lords, I--I have made the earth with man, and the cattle that are on the face of the earth, by My great power, and by My stretched-out arm, and I have given it to whom it has been right in My eyes.
27.6: `And now, I--I have given all these lands into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, My servant, and also the beast of the field I have given to him to serve him;
27.7: And served him have all the nations, and his son, and his son's son, till the coming in of the time of his land, also it; and done service for him have many nations and great kings.
27.8: And it has come to pass, the nation and the kingdom that do not serve him--Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon--and that which puts not its neck into the yoke of the king of Babylon, with sword, and with famine, and with pestilence, I lay a charge on that nation--an affirmation of Jehovah--till I consume them by his hand.
27.9: `And you, you do not hearken to your prophets, and to your diviners, and to your dreamers, and to your observers of clouds, and to your sorcerers who are speaking to you, saying, You do not serve the king of Babylon, --
27.10: For falsehood they are prophesying to you, so as to remove you far from off your ground, and I have driven you out, and you have perished.
27.11: And the nation that causes its neck to enter into the yoke of the king of Babylon, and has served him--I have left it on its ground--an affirmation of Jehovah--and it has tilled it, and dwelt in it.'
27.12: And to Zedekiah king of Judah I have spoken according to all these words, saying, `Cause your necks to enter into the yoke of the king of Babylon, and serve him and his people, and live.
27.13: Why do you die, you and your people, by sword, by famine, and by pestilence, as Jehovah has spoken concerning the nation that does not serve the king of Babylon?
27.14: `And you do not hearken to the words of the prophets who are speaking to you, saying, You do not serve the king of Babylon, --for falsehood they are prophesying to you.
27.15: For I have not sent them--an affirmation of Jehovah--and they are prophesying in My name falsely, so as to drive you out, and you have perished, you, and the prophets who are prophesying to you.'
27.16: And to the priests, and to all this people, I have spoken, saying, `Thus said Jehovah, You do not hearken to the words of your prophets, who are prophesying to you, saying, Indeed, the vessels of the house of Jehovah are brought back from Babylon now in haste, for falsehood they are prophesying to you.
27.17: You do not hearken to them, serve the king of Babylon, and live. Why is this city a waste?
27.18: `And, if they be prophets, and if a word of Jehovah be with them, let them intercede, I pray you, with Jehovah of Hosts, so that the vessels that are left in the house of Jehovah, and in the house of the king of Judah, and in Jerusalem, have not gone into Babylon.
27.19: For thus said Jehovah of Hosts concerning the pillars, and concerning the sea, and concerning the bases, and concerning the rest of the vessels that are left in this city,
27.20: That Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has not taken, in his removing Jeconiah son of Jehoiakim king of Judah from Jerusalem to Babylon with all the freemen of Judah and Jerusalem,
27.21: Surely thus said Jehovah of Hosts, God of Israel, concerning the vessels that are left of the house of Jehovah, and of the house of the king of Judah, and in Jerusalem:
27.22: To Babylon they are brought, and there they are till the day of My inspecting them--an affirmation of Jehovah; then I have brought them up, and have brought them back to this place.'

28.1: And it comes to pass, in that year, in the beginning of the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah, in the fourth year, in the fifth month, spoken to me has Hananiah son of Azur the prophet, who is of Gibeon, in the house of Jehovah, before the eyes of the priests, and all the people, saying,
28.2: `Thus spoke Jehovah of Hosts, God of Israel, saying, I have broken the yoke of the king of Babylon;
28.3: Within two years of days I am bringing back to this place all the vessels of the house of Jehovah that Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon has taken from this place, and does carry to Babylon,
28.4: And Jeconiah son of Jehoiakim, king of Judah, and all the removed of Judah, who are entering Babylon, I am bringing back to this place--an affirmation of Jehovah; for I do break the yoke of the king of Babylon.'
28.5: And Jeremiah the prophet says to Hananiah the prophet, before the eyes of the priests, and before the eyes of all the people who are standing in the house of Jehovah,
28.6: Yes, Jeremiah the prophet says, `Amen! so may Jehovah do; Jehovah establish your words that you have prophesied, to bring back the vessels of the house of Jehovah and all the removal from Babylon, to this place.
28.7: `Only, hear, I pray you, this word that I am speaking in your ears, and in the ears of all the people.
28.8: The prophets who have been before me, and before you, from of old, even they prophesy concerning many lands, and concerning great kingdoms, of battle, and of evil, and of pestilence.
28.9: The prophet who does prophesy of peace--by the coming in of the word of the prophet, known is the prophet that Jehovah has truly sent him.'
28.10: And Hananiah the prophet takes the yoke from off the neck of Jeremiah the prophet, and breaks it,
28.11: And Hananiah speaks before the eyes of all the people, saying, `Thus said Jehovah, Thus I break the yoke of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, within two years of days, from off the neck of all the nations;' and Jeremiah the prophet goes on his way.
28.12: And there is a word of Jehovah to Jeremiah after the breaking, by Hananiah the prophet, of the yoke from off the neck of Jeremiah the prophet, saying,
28.13: `Go, and you have spoken to Hananiah, saying, Thus said Jehovah, Yokes of wood you have broken, and I have made instead of them yokes of iron;
28.14: For thus said Jehovah of Hosts, God of Israel, A yoke of iron I have put on the neck of all these nations to serve Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and they have served him, and also the beast of the field I have given to him.'
28.15: And Jeremiah the prophet says to Hananiah the prophet, `Hear, I pray you, O Hananiah; Jehovah has not sent you, and you have caused this people to trust on falsehood.
28.16: Therefore thus said Jehovah, Indeed, I am casting you from off the face of the ground; this year you die, for apostasy you have spoken concerning Jehovah.'
28.17: And Hananiah the prophet dies in that year, in the seventh month.

29.1: And these are words of the letter that Jeremiah the prophet sent from Jerusalem to the remnant of the elders of the removal, and to the priests, and to the prophets, and to all the people--whom Nebuchadnezzar removed from Jerusalem to Babylon,
29.2: After the going forth of Jeconiah the king, and the mistress, and the officers, heads of Judah and Jerusalem, and the artificer, and the smith, from Jerusalem--
29.3: By the hand of Eleasah son of Shaphan, and Gemariah son of Hilkijah, whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon--to Babylon, saying,
29.4: `Thus said Jehovah of Hosts, God of Israel, to all the removal that I removed from Jerusalem to Babylon,
29.5: Build you houses, and abide; and plant you gardens, and eat their fruit;
29.6: Take you wives, and beget sons and daughters; and take for your sons wives, and your daughters give to husbands, and they bear sons and daughters; and multiply there, and you are not few;
29.7: And seek the peace of the city where I have removed you, and pray for it to Jehovah, for in its peace you have peace.
29.8: `For thus said Jehovah of Hosts, God of Israel, Let not your prophets who are in your midst, and your diviners, lift you up, nor hearken you to their dreams, that you are causing them to dream;
29.9: For with falsehood they are prophesying to you in My name; I have not sent them, an affirmation of Jehovah.
29.10: `For thus said Jehovah, Surely at the fulness of Babylon--seventy years--I inspect you, and have established toward you My good word, to bring you back to this place.
29.11: For I have known the thoughts that I am thinking toward you--an affirmation of Jehovah; thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give to you posterity and hope.
29.12: `And you have called Me, and have gone, and have prayed to Me, and I have hearkened to you,
29.13: And you have sought Me, and have found, for you seek Me with all your heart;
29.14: And I have been found of you--an affirmation of Jehovah; and I have turned back to your captivity, and have gathered you out of all the nations, and out of all the places where I have driven you--an affirmation of Jehovah--and I have brought you back to the place from where I removed you.
29.15: `Because you have said, Jehovah has raised up to us prophets in Babylon,
29.16: Surely thus said Jehovah concerning the king who is sitting on the throne of David, and concerning all the people that is dwelling in this city, your brethren who went not forth with you in the removal;
29.17: Thus said Jehovah of Hosts, Indeed, I am sending among them the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, and I have given them up as figs that are vile, that are not eaten for badness.
29.18: And I have pursued after them with sword, with famine, and with pestilence, and have given them for a trembling to all kingdoms of the earth, for a curse and for an astonishment, and for a hissing, and for a reproach among all the nations where I have driven them,
29.19: Because that they have not hearkened to My words--an affirmation of Jehovah--that I sent to them by My servants the prophets, rising early and sending, and you hearkened not--an affirmation of Jehovah.
29.20: `And you, hear you a word of Jehovah, all you of the captivity that I have sent from Jerusalem to Babylon,
29.21: Thus said Jehovah of Hosts, God of Israel, concerning Ahab son of Kolaiah, and concerning Zedekiah son of Maaseiah, who are prophesying to you in My name falsehood: Indeed, I am giving them into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and he has smitten them before your eyes,
29.22: And taken from them has been a reviling by all the removed of Judah that are in Babylon, saying, Jehovah does set you as Zedekiah, and as Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted with fire;
29.23: Because that they have done folly in Israel, and commit adultery with the wives of their neighbours, and speak a word in My name falsely that I have not commanded them, and I am He who knows and a witness--an affirmation of Jehovah.
29.24: `And to Shemaiah the Nehelamite you do speak, saying,
29.25: Thus said Jehovah of Hosts, God of Israel, saying, Because that you have sent in your name letters to all the people who are in Jerusalem, and to Zephaniah son of Maaseiah the priest, and to all the priests, saying,
29.26: Jehovah has made you priest instead of Jehoiada the priest, for there being inspectors of the house of Jehovah, for every one mad and making himself a prophet, and you have put him to the torture and to the stocks.
29.27: And now, why have you not pushed against Jeremiah of Anathoth, who is making himself a prophet to you?
29.28: Because that he has sent to us to Babylon, saying, It is long, build you houses, and abide; and plant you gardens, and eat their fruit.'
29.29: And Zephaniah the priest reads this letter in the ears of Jeremiah the prophet.
29.30: And there is a word of Jehovah to Jeremiah, saying,
29.31: `Send to all the removal, saying, Thus said Jehovah concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite, Because that Shemaiah prophesied to you, and I--I have not sent him, and he does cause you to trust on falsehood,
29.32: Therefore, thus said Jehovah, Indeed, I am seeing after Shemaiah the Nehelamite, and after his seed, he has none dwelling in the midst of this people, nor does he look on the good that I am doing to My people--an affirmation of Jehovah--for apostasy he has spoken against Jehovah.'

30.1: The word that has been to Jeremiah from Jehovah, saying,
30.2: `Thus spoke Jehovah, God of Israel, saying, Write for you all the words that I have spoken to you on a book.
30.3: For, indeed, days are coming--an affirmation of Jehovah--and I have turned back to the captivity of My people Israel and Judah, said Jehovah, and I have caused them to turn back to the land that I gave to their fathers, and they do possess it.'
30.4: And these are the words that Jehovah has spoken concerning Israel and concerning Judah:
30.5: Surely thus said Jehovah: A voice of trembling we have heard, Fear--and there is no peace.
30.6: Ask, I pray you, and see, is a male bringing forth? Wherefore have I seen every man, His hands on his loins, as a travailing woman, And all faces have been turned to paleness?
30.7: Woe! for great is that day, without any like it, Yes, a time of adversity it is to Jacob, Yet out of it he is saved.
30.8: And it has come to pass, in that day, An affirmation of Jehovah of Hosts, I break his yoke from off your neck, And your bands I draw away, And lay no more service on him do strangers.
30.9: And they have served Jehovah their God, And David their king whom I raise up to them.
30.10: And you, be not afraid, My servant Jacob, An affirmation of Jehovah, Nor be affrighted, O Israel, For, indeed, I am saving you from afar, And your seed from the land of their captivity, And Jacob has turned back and rested, And is quiet, and there is none troubling.
30.11: For with you am I, An affirmation of Jehovah--to save you, For I make an end of all the nations Where I have scattered you, Only, of you I do not make an end, And I have chastised you in judgment, And do not entirely acquit you.
30.12: For thus said Jehovah: Incurable is your breach, grievous your stroke,
30.13: There is none judging your cause to bind up, Healing medicines there are none for you.
30.14: all loving you have forgotten you, You they do not seek, For with the stroke of an enemy I smote you, The chastisement of a fierce one, Because of the abundance of your iniquity, Mighty have been your sins!
30.15: What! --you cry concerning your breach! Incurable is your pain, Because of the abundance of your iniquity, Mighty have been your sins! I have done these to you.
30.16: Therefore all consuming you are consumed, And all your adversaries--all of them--Into captivity do go, And your spoilers have been for a spoil, And all your plunderers I give up to plunder.
30.17: For I increase health to you, And from your strokes I do heal you, An affirmation of Jehovah, For `Outcast' they have called to you, `Zion it is, there is none seeking for her.'
30.18: Thus said Jehovah: Indeed, I turn back to the captivity of the tents of Jacob, And his dwelling places I pity, And the city has been built on its heap, And the palace according to its ordinance remains.
30.19: And gone forth from them has thanksgiving, And the voice of playful ones, And I have multiplied them and they are not few, And made them honourable, and they are not small.
30.20: And his sons have been as aforetime, And his company before Me is established, And I have seen after all his oppressors.
30.21: And his honourable one has been of himself, And his ruler from his midst goes forth, And I have caused him to draw near, And he has drawn nigh to Me, For who is he who has pledged his heart To draw nigh to Me? An affirmation of Jehovah.
30.22: And you have been to Me for a people, And I am to you for God.
30.23: Indeed, a whirlwind of Jehovah--Fury has gone forth--a cutting whirlwind, On the head of the wicked it stays.
30.24: The fierceness of the anger of Jehovah Does not turn back till His doing, Yes, till His establishing the devices of His heart, In the latter end of the days we consider it!

31.1: At that time, an affirmation of Jehovah, I am for God to all families of Israel, And they--they are to Me for a people.
31.2: Thus said Jehovah: Found grace in the wilderness Has a people remaining from the sword Going to cause it to rest--Israel.
31.3: From afar Jehovah has appeared to me, With love age-during I have loved you, Therefore I have drawn you with kindness.
31.4: Again do I build you, And you have been built, O virgin of Israel, Again you put on your tabrets, And have gone out in the chorus of the playful.
31.5: Again you do plant vineyards In mountains of Samaria, Planters have planted, and made common.
31.6: For there is a day, Cried have watchmen on mount Ephraim, `Rise, and we go up to Zion, to Jehovah our God;
31.7: For thus said Jehovah: Sing, O you to Jacob, with joy, And cry aloud at the head of the nations, Sound you, praise you, and say, Save, O Jehovah, your people, the remnant of Israel.
31.8: Indeed, I am bringing them in from the north country, And have gathered them from the sides of the earth, Among them are blind and lame, Conceiving and travailing one--together, A great assembly--they turn back here.
31.9: With weeping they come in, And with supplications I bring them, I cause them to go to streams of waters, In a right way--they stumble not in it, For I have been to Israel for a father, And Ephraim--My first-born is he.
31.10: Hear a word of Jehovah, O nations, And declare you among isles afar off, and say: He who is scattering Israel does gather him, And has kept him as a shepherd does his flock,
31.11: For Jehovah has ransomed Jacob, And redeemed him from a hand stronger than he.
31.12: And they have come in, And have sung in the high place of Zion, And flowed to the goodness of Jehovah, For wheat, and for new wine, and for oil, And for the young of the flock and herd, And their soul has been as a watered garden, And they add not to grieve any more.
31.13: Then rejoice does a virgin in a chorus, Both young men and old men--together, And I have turned their mourning to joy, And have comforted them, And gladdened them above their sorrow,
31.14: And satisfied the soul of the priests with fatness, And My people with My goodness are satisfied, An affirmation of Jehovah.
31.15: Thus said Jehovah, A voice in Ramah is heard, wailing, weeping most bitter, Rachel is weeping for her sons, She has refused to be comforted for her sons, because they are not.
31.16: Thus said Jehovah: Withhold your voice from weeping, and your eyes from tears, For there is a reward for your work, An affirmation of Jehovah, And they have turned back from the land of the enemy.
31.17: And there is hope for your latter end, An affirmation of Jehovah, And the sons have turned back to their border.
31.18: I have surely heard Ephraim bemoaning himself, `You have chastised me, And I am chastised, as a heifer not taught, Turn me back, and I turn back, For you are Jehovah my God.
31.19: For after my turning back I repented, And after my being instructed I struck on the thigh, I have been ashamed, I have also blushed, For I have borne the reproach of my youth.
31.20: A precious son is Ephraim to Me? A child of delights? For since My speaking against him, I do thoroughly remember him still, Therefore have My bowels been moved for him, I do greatly love him, An affirmation of Jehovah.
31.21: Set up for you signs, make for you heaps, Set your heart to the highway, the way you went, Turn back, O virgin of Israel, Turn back to these your cities.
31.22: Till when do you withdraw yourself, O backsliding daughter? For Jehovah has prepared a new thing in the land, Woman does compass man.
31.23: Thus said Jehovah of Hosts, God of Israel, Still they say this word in the land of Judah, And in its cities, In My turning back to their captivity, Jehovah does bless you, habitation of righteousness, Mountain of holiness.
31.24: And dwelt in Judah have husbandmen, and in all its cities together, And they have journeyed in order.
31.25: For I have satiated the weary soul, And every grieved soul I have filled.'
31.26: On this I have awaked, and I behold, and my sleep has been sweet to me.
31.27: Indeed, days are coming, an affirmation of Jehovah, And I have sown the house of Israel, And the house of Judah, With seed of man, and seed of beast.
31.28: And it has been, as I watched over them to pluck up, And to break down, and to throw down, And to destroy, and to afflict; So do I watch over them to build, and to plant, An affirmation of Jehovah.
31.29: In those days they do not say any more: Fathers have eaten unripe fruit, And the sons' teeth are blunted.
31.30: But--each for his own iniquity does die, Every man who is eating the unripe fruit, Blunted are his teeth.
31.31: Indeed, days are coming, an affirmation of Jehovah, And I have made with the house of Israel And with the house of Judah a new covenant,
31.32: Not like the covenant that I made with their fathers, In the day of My laying hold on their hand, To bring them out of the land of Egypt, In that they made void My covenant, And I ruled over them--an affirmation of Jehovah.
31.33: For this is the covenant that I make, With the house of Israel, after those days, An affirmation of Jehovah, I have given My law in their inward part, And on their heart I do write it, And I have been to them for God, And they are to me for a people.
31.34: And they do not teach any more Each his neighbour, and each his brother, Saying, Know you Jehovah, For they all know Me, from their least to their greatest, An affirmation of Jehovah; For I pardon their iniquity, And of their sin I make mention no more.
31.35: Thus said Jehovah, Who is giving the sun for a light by day, The statutes of moon and stars for a light by night, Quieting the sea when its billows roar, Jehovah of Hosts is His name:
31.36: If these statutes depart from before Me, An affirmation of Jehovah, Even the seed of Israel does cease From being a nation before Me all the days.
31.37: Thus said Jehovah: If the heavens above be measured, And the foundations of earth below searched, Even I kick against all the seed of Israel, For all that they have done, An affirmation of Jehovah.
31.38: Indeed, days are coming, an affirmation of Jehovah, And the city has been built to Jehovah, From the tower of Hananeel to the gate of the corner.
31.39: And gone out again has the measuring line Over-against it, to the height of Gareb, And it has compassed to Goah.
31.40: And all the valley of the carcases and of the ashes, And all the fields to the brook Kidron, To the corner of the horse-gate eastward, Are holy to Jehovah, it is not plucked up, Nor is it thrown down any more to the age!

32.1: The word that has been to Jeremiah from Jehovah, in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah--it is the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar,
32.2: And then the forces of the king of Babylon are laying siege against Jerusalem, and Jeremiah the prophet has been shut up in the court of the prison that is in the house of the king of Judah,
32.3: Where Zedekiah king of Judah has shut him up, saying, `Wherefore are you prophesying, saying, Thus said Jehovah, Indeed, I am giving this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he has captured it;
32.4: And Zedekiah king of Judah does not escape out of the hand of the Chaldeans, but is certainly given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and his mouth has spoken with his mouth, and his eyes see his eyes,
32.5: And to Babylon he leads Zedekiah, and there he is till My inspecting him, --an affirmation of Jehovah--because you fight with the Chaldeans, you do not prosper.'
32.6: And Jeremiah says, `A word of Jehovah has been to me saying,
32.7: Indeed, Hanameel son of Shallum, your uncle, is coming to you, saying, Buy for you my field that is in Anathoth, for yours is the right of redemption--to buy.
32.8: And Hanameel, my uncle's son, comes in to me, according to the word of Jehovah, to the court of the prison, and says to me, `Buy, I pray you, my field that is in Anathoth, that is in the land of Benjamin, for yours is the right of possession, and your of redemption--buy for you.' And I know that it is the word of Jehovah,
32.9: And I buy the field, that is in Anathoth, from Hanameel, my uncle's son, and I weigh to him the money--seventeen shekels of silver.
32.10: And I write in a book, and seal, and cause witnesses to testify, and weigh the silver in balances;
32.11: And I take the purchase-book, the sealed one, according to law and custom, and the open one.
32.12: And I give the purchase-book to Baruch son of Neriah, son of Maaseiah, before the eyes of Hanameel, my uncle's son, and before the eyes of the witnesses, those writing in the purchase-book, before the eyes of all the Jews who are sitting in the court of the prison.
32.13: And I charge Baruch before their eyes, saying,
32.14: `Thus said Jehovah of Hosts, God of Israel, Take these books, this purchase-book, both the sealed one and the open one, and you have put them in an earthen vessel, that they may remain many days;
32.15: For thus said Jehovah of Hosts, God of Israel, Again are houses and fields and vineyards bought in this land.'
32.16: And I pray to Jehovah--after my giving the purchase-book to Baruch son of Neriah--saying,
32.17: `Ah, Lord Jehovah, indeed, You have made the heavens and the earth by Your great power, and by Your stretched-out arm; there is nothing too wonderful for You:
32.18: Doing kindness to thousands, and recompensing iniquity of fathers into the bosom of their sons after them; God, the great, the mighty, Jehovah of Hosts is His name,
32.19: Great in counsel, and mighty in act, in that Your eyes are open on all the ways of the sons of Adam, to give to each according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings:
32.20: In that you have done signs and wonders in the land of Egypt to this day, and in Israel, and among men, and You do make for You a name as at this day.
32.21: `And You bring forth Your people Israel from the land of Egypt, with signs and with wonders, and by a strong hand, and by a stretched-out arm, and by great fear,
32.22: And you give to them this land that you did swear to their fathers to give to them, a land flowing with milk and honey,
32.23: And they come in, and possess it, and they have not hearkened to Your voice, and in Your law have not walked, all that which You did lay a charge on them to do they have not done, and You do proclaim to them all this evil.
32.24: `Indeed, the mounts--they have come in to the city to capture it, and the city has been given into the hand of the Chaldeans who are fighting against it, because of the sword, and the famine, and the pestilence; and that which You have spoken has come to pass, and indeed, You are seeing;
32.25: Yet You have said to me, O Lord Jehovah, Buy for you the field with money, and cause witnesses to testify--and the city has been given into the hand of the Chaldeans!'
32.26: And the word of Jehovah is to Jeremiah, saying:
32.27: `Indeed, I am Jehovah, God of all flesh: For Me is anything too wonderful?
32.28: `Therefore, thus said Jehovah, Indeed, I am giving this city into the hand of the Chaldeans, and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and he has captured it;
32.29: And come in have the Chaldeans who are fighting against this city, and they have set this city on fire, and have burned it, and the houses on whose roofs they made perfume to Baal, and poured out libations to other gods, so as to provoke Me to anger.
32.30: For the sons of Israel and the sons of Judah have been only doing evil in My eyes, from their youth; for the sons of Israel are only provoking Me with the work of their hands--an affirmation of Jehovah.
32.31: `For a cause of My anger, and a cause of My fury, has this city been to Me, even from the day that they built it, and to this day--to turn it aside from before My face,
32.32: Because of all the evil of the sons of Israel, and of the sons of Judah that they have done, so as to provoke Me--they, their kings, their heads, their priests, and their prophets, and the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
32.33: And they turn to Me the neck, and not the face, and teaching them, rising early and teaching, and they are not hearkening to accept instruction.
32.34: `And they set their abominations in the house over which My name is called, so as to defile it;
32.35: And they build the high places of Baal, that are in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to cause their sons and their daughters to pass through to Molech, which I did not command them, nor did it come up on my heart to do this abomination, so as to cause Judah to sin.
32.36: `And now, therefore, thus said Jehovah, God of Israel, concerning this city, of which you are saying, It has been given into the hand of the king of Babylon by sword, and by famine, and by pestilence,
32.37: Indeed, I am gathering them out of all the lands where I have driven them in My anger, and in My fury, and in great wrath, and I have brought them back to this place, and have caused them to dwell confidently;
32.38: and they have been to Me for a people, and I am to them for God;
32.39: and I have given to them one heart, and one way, to fear Me all the days, for good to them, and to their sons after them:
32.40: and I have made for them a covenant age-during, in that I turn not back from after them for My doing them good, and My fear I put in their heart, so as not to turn aside from me;
32.41: and I have rejoiced over them to do them good, and have planted them in this land in truth, with all my heart, and with all My soul.
32.42: `For thus said Jehovah: As I brought in to this people all this great evil, so I am bringing in on them all the good that I am speaking concerning them;
32.43: and bought has been the field in this land of which you are saying, A desolation it is, without man and beast, it has been given into the hand of the Chaldeans.
32.44: Fields with money they buy, so as to write in a book, and to seal, and to cause witnesses to testify, in the land of Benjamin, and in suburbs of Jerusalem, and in cities of Judah, and in cities of the hill-country, and in cities of the low country, and in cities of the south, for I turn back their captivity--an affirmation of Jehovah.'

33.1: And there is a word of Jehovah to Jeremiah a second time--and he is yet detained in the court of the prison--saying:
33.2: Thus said Jehovah its maker, Jehovah its former, at establishing it, Jehovah is His name:
33.3: Call to Me, and I do answer you, yes, I declare to you great and fenced things--you have not known them.
33.4: For thus said Jehovah, God of Israel, concerning the houses of this city, and concerning the houses of the kings of Judah, that are broken down for the mounts, and for the tool;
33.5: they are coming in to fight with the Chaldeans, and to fill them with the carcases of men, whom I have smitten in My anger, and in My fury, and for whom I have hidden My face from this city, because of all their evil:
33.6: Indeed, I am increasing to it health and cure, And have healed them, and revealed to them The abundance of peace and truth.
33.7: And I have turned back the captivity of Judah, And the captivity of Israel, And I have built them as at the first,
33.8: And cleansed them from all their iniquity, That they have sinned against Me, And I have pardoned all their iniquities, That they have sinned against Me, And that they transgressed against Me.
33.9: And it has been to Me for a name of joy, For praise, and for beauty, to all nations of the earth, Who hear of all the good that I am doing them, And they have feared, And they have trembled for all the good, And for all the peace, that I am doing to it.
33.10: Thus said Jehovah: Again heard in this place of which you are saying, Waste it is, without man and without beast, In cities of Judah, and in streets of Jerusalem, That are desolated, without man, And without inhabitant, and without beast,
33.11: Is a voice of joy and a voice of gladness, Voice of bridegroom, and voice of bride, The voice of those saying, Thank Jehovah of Hosts, for Jehovah is good, For His kindness is to the age, Who are bringing in thanksgiving to the house of Jehovah, For I turn back the captivity of the land, As at the first, said Jehovah.
33.12: Thus said Jehovah of Hosts: Again there is in this place--that is waste, Without man and beast, And in all its cities--a habitation of shepherds, Causing the flock to lie down.
33.13: In the cities of the hill-country, In the cities of the low country, And in the cities of the south, And in the land of Benjamin, And in the suburbs of Jerusalem, And in the cities of Judah, Again does the flock pass by under the hands of the numberer, said Jehovah.
33.14: Indeed, days are coming, an affirmation of Jehovah, And I have established the good word That I spoke to the house of Israel, And concerning the house of Judah.
33.15: In those days, and at that time, I cause to shoot up to David a shoot of righteousness, And he has done judgment and righteousness in the earth.
33.16: In those days is Judah saved, And Jerusalem does dwell confidently, And this is he whom Jehovah proclaims to her: `Our Righteousness.'
33.17: For thus said Jehovah: `Not cut off to David is one sitting on the throne of the house of Israel,
33.18: And to the priests--the Levites, Not cut off from before Me is one, Causing a burnt-offering to ascend, And perfuming a present, and making sacrifice--all the days.'
33.19: And there is a word of Jehovah to Jeremiah, saying,
33.20: `Thus said Jehovah: If you do break My covenant of the day, And My covenant of the night, So that they are not daily and nightly in their season,
33.21: Also My covenant is broken with David My servant, So that he has not a son reigning on his throne, And with the Levites the priests, My ministers.
33.22: As the host of the heavens is not numbered, Nor the sand of the sea measured, So I multiply the seed of David My servant, And the Levites My ministers.'
33.23: And there is a word of Jehovah to Jeremiah, saying:
33.24: `Have you not considered what this people have spoken, saying: The two families on which Jehovah fixed, He does reject them, And my people they despise--So that they are no more a people before them!
33.25: Thus said Jehovah: If My covenant is not daily and nightly, The statutes of heaven and earth I have not appointed--
33.26: Also the seed of Jacob, and David My servant, I reject, Against taking from his seed rulers For the seed of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, For I turn back to their captivity, and have pitied them.'

34.1: The word that has been to Jeremiah from Jehovah--and Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and all his force, and all kingdoms of the land of the dominion of his hand, and all the peoples are fighting against Jerusalem, and against all its cities--saying:
34.2: `Thus said Jehovah, God of Israel: Go, and you have spoken to Zedekiah king of Judah, and have said to him, Thus said Jehovah: Indeed, I am giving this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he has burned it with fire,
34.3: and you, you do not escape out of his hand, for you are certainly caught, and into his hand you are given, and your eyes see the eyes of the king of Babylon, and his mouth with your mouth speaks, and Babylon you enter.
34.4: `Only, hear a word of Jehovah, O Zedekiah king of Judah, Thus said Jehovah to you: You do not die by sword,
34.5: in peace you die, and with the burnings of your fathers, the former kings who have been before you, so they make a burning for you; and Ah, lord, they lament for you, for the word I have spoken--an affirmation of Jehovah.'
34.6: And Jeremiah the prophet speaks to Zedekiah king of Judah all these words in Jerusalem,
34.7: and the forces of the king of Babylon are fighting against Jerusalem, and against all the cities of Judah that are left--against Lachish, and against Azekah, for these have been left among the cities of Judah, cities of fortresses.
34.8: The word that has been to Jeremiah from Jehovah, after the making by the king Zedekiah of a covenant with all the people who are in Jerusalem, to proclaim to them liberty,
34.9: to send out each his man-servant, and each his maid-servant--the Hebrew and the Hebrewess--free, so as not to lay service on them, any on a Jew his brother;
34.10: and hearken do all the heads, and all the people who have come in to the covenant to send forth each his man-servant and each his maid-servant free, so as not to lay service on them any more, yes, they hearken, and send them away;
34.11: and they turn afterwards, and cause the men-servants and the maid-servants to return, whom they had sent forth free, and they subdue them for men-servants and for maid-servants.
34.12: And there is a word of Jehovah to Jeremiah from Jehovah, saying:
34.13: `Thus said Jehovah, God of Israel, I--I made a covenant with your fathers in the day of My bringing them forth from the land of Egypt, from a house of servants, saying,
34.14: At the end of seven years you do send forth each his brother, the Hebrew, who is sold to you, and has served you six years, yes, you have sent him forth free from you: and your fathers hearkened not to Me, nor inclined their ear.
34.15: `And you turn back, you to-day, and you do that which is right in My eyes, to proclaim liberty each to his neighbour, and you make a covenant before Me in the house over which My name is called.
34.16: And--you turn back, and pollute My name, and you cause each his man-servant and each his maid-servant, whom he had sent forth free, (at their pleasure,) to return, and you subdue them to be to you for men-servants and for maid-servants.
34.17: `Therefore, thus said Jehovah: You have not hearkened to Me to proclaim freedom, each to his brother, and each to his neighbour; indeed, I am proclaiming to you liberty--an affirmation of Jehovah--to the sword, to the pestilence, and to the famine, and I have given you for a trembling to all kingdoms of the earth.
34.18: `And I have given the men who are transgressing My covenant, who have not established the words of the covenant that they have made before Me, by the calf, that they have cut in two, and pass through between its pieces--
34.19: heads of Judah, and heads of Jerusalem, the officers, and the priests, and all the people of the land those passing through between the pieces of the calf--
34.20: yes, I have given them into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those seeking their soul, and their carcase has been for food to the fowl of the heavens, and to the beast of the earth.
34.21: `And Zedekiah king of Judah, and his heads, I give into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those seeking their soul, and into the hand of the forces of the king of Babylon, that are going up from off you.
34.22: Indeed, I am commanding--an affirmation of Jehovah--and have brought them back to this city, and they have fought against it, and captured it, and burned it with fire, and the cities of Judah I do make a desolation--without inhabitant.'

35.1: The word that has been to Jeremiah from Jehovah, in the days of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, saying:
35.2: `Go to the house of the Rechabites, and you have spoken with them, and brought them into the house of Jehovah, to one of the chambers, and caused them to drink wine.'
35.3: And I take Jaazaniah son of Jeremiah, son of Habazziniah, and his brethren, and all his sons, and all the house of the Rechabites,
35.4: and bring them into the house of Jehovah, to the chamber of the sons of Hanan son of Igdaliah, a man of God, that is near to the chamber of the princes, that is above the chamber of Maaseiah son of Shallum, keeper of the threshold;
35.5: and I put before the sons of the house of the Rechabites goblets full of wine, and cups, and I say to them, Drink you wine.
35.6: And they say, `We do not drink wine: for Jonadab son of Rechab, our father, charged us, saying, You do not drink wine, you and your sons--to the age;
35.7: and a house you do not build, and seed you do not sow, and a vineyard you do not plant, nor have you any; for in tents do you dwell all your days, that you may live many days on the face of the ground where you are sojourning.
35.8: `And we hearken to the voice of Jonadab son of Rechab, our father, to all that he commanded us, not to drink wine all our days, we, our wives, our sons, and our daughters;
35.9: nor to build houses for our dwelling; and vineyard, and field, and seed, we have none;
35.10: and we dwell in tents, and we hearken, and we do according to all that Jonadab our father commanded us;
35.11: and it comes to pass, in the coming up of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon to the land, that we say, Come, and we enter Jerusalem, because of the force of the Chaldeans, and because of the force of Aram--and we dwell in Jerusalem.'
35.12: And there is a word of Jehovah to Jeremiah, saying: `Thus said Jehovah of Hosts, God of Israel:
35.13: `Go, and you have said to the men of Judah, and to the inhabitants of Jerusalem: Do you not receive instruction? --to hearken to My words--an affirmation of Jehovah.
35.14: Performed have been the words of Jonadab son of Rechab, when he commanded his sons not to drink wine, and they have not drunk to this day, for they have obeyed the command of their father; and I--I have spoken to you, rising early and speaking, and you have not hearkened to Me.
35.15: And I send to you all My servants the prophets, rising early and sending, saying: Turn back, I pray you, each from his evil way, and amend your doings, yes, you do not walk after other gods, to serve them, and dwell you on the ground that I have given to you and to your fathers; and you have not inclined your ear, nor hearkened to Me.
35.16: `Because the sons of Jonadab son of Rechab have performed the command of their father, that he commanded them, and this people have not hearkened to Me,
35.17: therefore thus said Jehovah, God of Hosts, God of Israel: Indeed, I am bringing in to Judah, and to all inhabitants of Jerusalem, all the evil that I have spoken against them, because I have spoken to them, and they have not hearkened, yes, I call to them, and they have not answered.'
35.18: And to the house of the Rechabites said Jeremiah: `Thus said Jehovah of Hosts, God of Israel, Because that you have hearkened to the command of Jonadab your father, and you observe all his commands, and do according to all that he commanded you;
35.19: therefore, thus said Jehovah of Hosts, God of Israel, Of Jonadab son of Rechab one standing before me is not cut off all the days.'

36.1: And it comes to pass, in the fourth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, this word has been to Jeremiah from Jehovah, saying:
36.2: `Take to you a roll of a book, and you have written on it all the words that I have spoken to you concerning Israel, and concerning Judah, and concerning all the nations, from the day I spoke to you, from the days of Josiah, even to this day;
36.3: if so be the house of Israel do hear all the evil that I am thinking of doing to them, so that they turn back each from is evil way, and I have been propitious to their iniquity, and to their sin.'
36.4: And Jeremiah calls Baruch son of Neriah, and Baruch writes from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of Jehovah, that He has spoken to him, on a roll of a book.
36.5: And Jeremiah commands Baruch, saying, `I am restrained, I am not able to enter the house of Jehovah;
36.6: but you have entered--and you have read in the roll that you have written from my mouth, the words of Jehovah, in the ears of the people, in the house of Jehovah, in the day of the fast, and also in the ears of all Judah who are coming in from their cities you do read them;
36.7: if so be their supplication does fall before Jehovah, and they turn back each from his evil way, for great is the anger and the fury that Jehovah has spoken concerning this people.'
36.8: And Baruch son of Neriah does according to all that Jeremiah the prophet commanded him, to read in the book the words of Jehovah in the house of Jehovah.
36.9: And it comes to pass, in the fifth year of Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah, in the ninth month, proclaimed a fast before Jehovah have all the people in Jerusalem, and all the people who are coming in from cities of Judah to Jerusalem;
36.10: and Baruch reads in the book the words of Jeremiah in the house of Jehovah, in the chamber of Gemariah son of Shaphan the scribe, in the higher court, at the opening of the new gate of the house of Jehovah, in the ears of all the people.
36.11: And Michaiah son of Gemariah, son of Shaphan, hears all the words of Jehovah from off the book,
36.12: and he goes down to the house of the king, to the chamber of the scribe, and indeed, there are all the heads sitting: Elishama the scribe, and Delaiah son of Shemaiah, and Elnathan son of Acbor, and Gemariah son of Shaphan, and Zedekiah son of Hananiah, and all the heads.
36.13: And declare to them does Micaiah all the words that he has heard, when Baruch reads in the book in the ears of the people;
36.14: and all the heads send to Baruch, Jehudi son of Nethaniah, son of Shelemiah, son of Cushi, saying, `The roll in which you have read in the ears of the people take in your hand, and come.' And Baruch son of Neriah takes the roll in his hand and comes in to them,
36.15: and they say to him, `Sit down, we pray you, and read it in our ears,' and Baruch reads in their ears,
36.16: and it comes to pass, when they hear all the words, they have been afraid one at another, and say to Baruch, `We do surely declare to the king all these words.'
36.17: And they asked Baruch, saying, `Declare, we pray you, to us, how did you write all these words--from his mouth?'
36.18: And Baruch says to them, `From his mouth, he pronounces to me all these words, and I am writing on the book with ink.'
36.19: And the heads say to Baruch, `Go, be hidden, you and Jeremiah, and let no one know where you are.'
36.20: And they go in to the king, to the court, and the roll they have laid up in the chamber of Elishama the scribe, and they declare in the ears of the king all the words.
36.21: And the king sends Jehudi to take the roll, and he takes it out of the chamber of Elishama the scribe, and Jehudi reads it in the ears of the king, and in the ears of all the heads who are standing by the king;
36.22: and the king is sitting in the winter-house, in the ninth month, and the stove before him is burning,
36.23: and it comes to pass, when Jehudi reads three or four leaves, he cuts it out with the scribe's knife, and has cast to the fire, that is on the stove, till the consumption of all the roll by the fire that is on the stove.
36.24: And the king and all his servants who are hearing all these words have not been afraid, nor rent their garments.
36.25: And also Elnathan, and Delaiah, and Gemariah have interceded with the king not to burn the roll, and he has not hearkened to them.
36.26: And the king commands Jerahmeel son of Hammelek, and Seraiah son of Azriel, and Shelemiah son of Abdeel, to take Baruch the scribe, and Jeremiah the prophet, and Jehovah does hide them.
36.27: And there is a word of Jehovah to Jeremiah--after the king's burning the roll, even the words that Baruch has written from the mouth of Jeremiah--saying:
36.28: `Turn, take to you another roll, and write on it all the former words that were on the first roll, that Jehoiakim king of Judah burnt,
36.29: and to Jehoiakim king of Judah you do say: Thus said Jehovah, You have burnt this roll, saying, Wherefore have you written on it, saying, The king of Babylon surely comes in, and has destroyed this land, and caused to cease from it man and beast?
36.30: `Therefore, thus said Jehovah, concerning Jehoiakim king of Judah: He has none sitting on the throne of David, and his carcase is cast out to heat by day, and to cold by night;
36.31: and I have charged on him, and on his seed, and on his servants, their iniquity; and I have brought in on them, and on the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the men of Judah, all the evil that I have spoken to them, and they hearkened not.'
36.32: And Jeremiah has taken another roll, and gives it to Baruch son of Neriah the scribe, and he writes on it from the mouth of Jeremiah all the words of the book that Jehoiakim king of Judah has burnt in the fire; and again there were added to them many words like these.

37.1: And reign does king Zedekiah son of Josiah instead of Coniah son of Jehoiakim whom Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon had caused to reign in the land of Judah,
37.2: and he has not hearkened, he, and his servants, and the people of the land, to the words of Jehovah, that He spoke by the hand of Jeremiah the prophet.
37.3: And Zedekiah the king sends Jehucal son of Shelemiah, and Zephaniah son of Maaseiah the priest, to Jeremiah the prophet, saying, `Pray, we beseech you, for us to Jehovah our God.'
37.4: And Jeremiah is coming in and going out in the midst of the people, (and they have not put him in the prison-house),
37.5: and the force of Pharaoh has come out of Egypt, and the Chaldeans, who are laying siege against Jerusalem, hear their report, and go up from off Jerusalem.
37.6: And there is a word of Jehovah to Jeremiah the prophet, saying:
37.7: `Thus said Jehovah, God of Israel, Thus do you say to the king of Judah, who is sending you to Me, to seek Me: Indeed, the force of Pharaoh that is coming out to you for help has turned back to its land, to Egypt,
37.8: and the Chaldeans have turned back, and fought against this city, and captured it, and burnt it with fire.
37.9: `Thus said Jehovah: Lift not up your souls saying, The Chaldeans surely go from off us, for they do not go;
37.10: for though you had smitten all the force of the Chaldeans who are fighting with you, and there were left of them wounded men--each in his tent--they rise, and have burnt this city with fire.'
37.11: And it has come to pass, in the going up of the force of the Chaldeans from off Jerusalem, because of the force of Pharaoh,
37.12: that Jeremiah goes out from Jerusalem to go to the land of Benjamin, to receive a portion from there in the midst of the people.
37.13: And it comes to pass, he is at the gate of Benjamin, and there is a master of the ward--and his name is Irijah son of Shelemiah, son of Hananiah--and he catches Jeremiah the prophet, saying, `To the Chaldeans you are falling.'
37.14: And Jeremiah says, `Falsehood--I am not falling to the Chaldeans;' and he has not hearkened to him, and Irijah lays hold on Jeremiah, and brings him in to the heads,
37.15: and the heads are wroth against Jeremiah, and have smitten him, and put him in the prison-house--the house of Jonathan the scribe, for it they had made for a prison-house.
37.16: When Jeremiah has entered into the house of the dungeon, and to the cells, then Jeremiah dwells there many days,
37.17: and the king Zedekiah sends, and takes him, and the king asks him in his house in secret, and says, `Is there a word from Jehovah?' And Jeremiah says, `There is,' and he says, `Into the hand of the king of Babylon you are given.'
37.18: And Jeremiah says to the king Zedekiah, `What have I sinned against you, and against your servants, and against this people, that you have given me to a prison-house?
37.19: And where are your prophets who prophesied to you, saying, The king of Babylon does not come in against you, and against this land?
37.20: And now, hearken, I pray you, my lord, O king, let my supplication fall, I pray you, before you, and cause me not to return to the house of Jonathan the scribe, that I die not there.'
37.21: And the king Zedekiah commands, and they commit Jeremiah into the court of the prison, also to give to him a cake of bread daily from the bakers' street, till the consumption of all the bread of the city, and Jeremiah dwells in the court of the prison.

38.1: And Shephatiah son of Mattan, and Gedaliah son of Pashhur, and Jucal son of Shelemiah, and Pashhur son of Malchiah, hear the words that Jeremiah is speaking to all the people, saying,
38.2: `Thus said Jehovah: He who is remaining in this city dies, by sword, by famine, and by pestilence, and he who is going forth to the Chaldeans lives, and his soul has been to him for a prey, and he lives.
38.3: Thus said Jehovah: This city is certainly given into the hand of the force of the king of Babylon, and he has captured it.'
38.4: And the heads say to the king, `Let, we pray you, this man be put to death, because that he is making feeble the hands of the men of war, who are left in this city, and the hands of all the people, by speaking to them according to these words, for this man is not seeking for the peace of this people, but for its evil.'
38.5: And the king Zedekiah says, `Indeed, he is in your hand: for the king is not able for you in anything.'
38.6: And they take Jeremiah, and cast him into the pit of Malchiah son of the king, that is in the court of the prison, and they send down Jeremiah with cords; and in the pit there is no water, but mire, and Jeremiah sinks in the mire.
38.7: And Ebed-Melech the Cushite, a eunuch who is in the king's house, hears that they have put Jeremiah into the pit; and the king is sitting at the gate of Benjamin,
38.8: and Ebed-Melech goes forth from the king's house, and speaks to the king, saying,
38.9: `My lord, O king, these men have done evil in all that they have done to Jeremiah the prophet, whom they have cast into the pit, and he dies in his place because of the famine, for there is no more bread in the city.'
38.10: And the king commands Ebed-Melech the Cushite, saying, `Take with you from this thirty men, and you have brought up Jeremiah the prophet from the pit, before he dies.'
